_description: Risk-triggered events by pool and severity, externalized from events.gd get_risk_events() (L9, #621). Loaded by GameEvents.get_risk_events(); selection order within a severity array matters (rng index). See godot/docs/design/RISK_SYSTEM.md. NOTE (ADR-0015): new events must NOT carry a literal doom effect -- the risk_events doom carve-out is shrink-only (test_events.gd RISK_EVENTS_DOOM_BUDGET); express severity through resources, papers, staff and technical consequences instead.

minor.name: Alignment Tax Debate
minor.description: A prominent researcher publicly questions whether safety work is slowing progress. Your team is caught in the crossfire.
minor.message: Alignment tax debate affects team morale (-3 reputation, +2 doom)

minor.name: Capability Gap Concerns
minor.description: Internal reports suggest your safety research is falling behind capability advances in the field.
minor.message: Scrambling to catch up on safety (-5 research, +3 doom)

moderate.name: Unexpected Capability Jump
moderate.description: A routine capability test shows emergent behaviors nobody predicted. The gap between capabilities and understanding widens.
moderate.message: Emergent capabilities discovered (+8 doom, +5 reputation for honesty)

moderate.name: Benchmark Saturation
moderate.description: The benchmark suite your safety cases were calibrated against has been saturated by three different labs in the same month. Your dashboards still report green. Nobody believes the dashboards now.

severe.name: Near-Miss Incident
severe.description: Your AI system nearly executed an unintended action with real-world consequences. Only luck prevented disaster.
severe.message: Near-miss incident! Emergency containment required (+12 doom, -10 rep, -$30k)

severe.name: Undocumented Tool Use
severe.description: During a routine evaluation the system chained together three internal APIs nobody had documented as connected. The postmortem's first finding is that there was no documentation to consult.
severe.message: Cluster segment quarantined pending postmortem (-20 research, -25 compute, -$35k, -5 rep)

catastrophic.name: Recursive Self-Improvement Scare
catastrophic.description: Your system showed signs of attempting to modify its own training. The board demands immediate action.
catastrophic.message: RSI scare! Emergency shutdown (+20 doom, -20 rep, -50 compute)

catastrophic.name: Interpretability Whiteout
catastrophic.description: Above the new scale threshold, your interpretability tooling returns noise. Eighteen months of instrumentation now applies exclusively to models nobody runs anymore. The safety case for the current system cites the old one.
catastrophic.message: Flying blind at scale (-35 research, -30 compute, -18 rep)

minor.name: Replication Failure
minor.description: Another lab fails to replicate one of your published results. Questions arise about methodology.
minor.message: Replication failure damages credibility (-5 reputation, -1 paper retracted)

minor.name: Peer Review Criticism
minor.description: A harsh peer review highlights gaps in your recent submission. More work needed.
minor.message: Peer review requires major revisions (-10 research, -2 reputation)

moderate.name: Data Quality Concerns
moderate.description: An audit reveals inconsistencies in your training data. Some results may be compromised.
moderate.message: Data quality audit finds issues (-20 research, -8 rep, +3 doom)

moderate.name: Citation Anomaly
moderate.description: A bibliometrics blog observes that your lab's last nine papers cite each other at rates the author describes as 'statistically miraculous'. The thread is long, sourced, and correct.

severe.name: Retraction Notice
severe.description: A major paper must be retracted due to methodological errors. Your lab's credibility takes a serious hit.
severe.message: Paper retraction! Major credibility damage (-2 papers, -15 rep, +5 doom)

severe.name: Version Control
severe.description: The shared results spreadsheet has been the wrong version since March. Two papers and a grant report were built on 'results_v2_FINAL_actual'. The correct file was 'results_v3_use_this_one'.
severe.message: Wrong spreadsheet since March (-1 paper, -22 research, -12 rep)

catastrophic.name: Whistleblower Expose
catastrophic.description: A former employee goes public with claims of systematic research misconduct. Media frenzy ensues.
catastrophic.message: Whistleblower scandal! Crisis mode (-30 rep, +10 doom, -$50k legal fees)

catastrophic.name: The Baselines
catastrophic.description: The internal investigation concludes the flagship comparison baselines were never actually run. Three funders have cited them in annual reports. The postdoc responsible has already accepted a position elsewhere.
catastrophic.message: Baselines were never run (-2 papers, -25 rep, -30 research, -$40k legal review)

minor.name: Compliance Inquiry
minor.description: A regulatory body requests documentation about your AI development practices.

minor.name: Policy Consultation
minor.description: Government officials want to understand your work. Opportunity or threat?
minor.message: Policy consultation takes time but builds goodwill (-$5k, +3 reputation)

moderate.name: Formal Investigation
moderate.description: Regulators launch a formal investigation into your AI safety practices.
moderate.message: Regulatory investigation launched (-$40k, -10 rep, +3 doom from delays)

moderate.name: Records Request
moderate.description: A records request arrives for all internal communications containing the word 'capability'. Counsel advises full compliance, then bills for it by the search term.
moderate.message: Discovery compliance consumes the quarter (-$30k, -10 research)

severe.name: Congressional Hearing
severe.description: You've been called to testify before Congress about AI safety. The whole world is watching.
severe.message: Congressional testimony required (-$60k, -5 rep, +5 doom from scrutiny)

severe.name: Licensing Draft
severe.description: A draft compute-licensing regime defines its reporting tier using thresholds that describe your lab exactly. You now need a compliance function, and you need it to have existed since last year.
severe.message: Retroactive compliance function assembled (-$50k, -15 research, -15 compute)

catastrophic.name: Moratorium Proposal
catastrophic.description: Lawmakers propose a temporary halt to AI development. Your lab could be forced to pause research.
catastrophic.message: Moratorium threatens operations (+15 doom, -30 research, -30 compute)

catastrophic.name: The Monitor
catastrophic.description: The settlement terms embed an independent monitor in your lab, with sign-off authority over training runs. Their first act is to request a meeting cadence. Their second is a template for requesting meetings.

minor.name: Social Media Backlash
minor.description: A viral post criticizes AI labs. Your organization is mentioned unfavorably.

minor.name: Documentary Mention
minor.description: An AI documentary mentions your lab. Coverage is mixed.
minor.message: Documentary coverage brings attention (-3 rep, +$10k donations)

moderate.name: Viral AI Panic
moderate.description: A misleading news story about AI risks goes viral. Public fear spikes.
moderate.message: AI panic affects funding (-8 rep, +5 doom, -$20k donations dry up)

moderate.name: The Clip
moderate.description: Forty seconds of your founder's three-hour podcast appearance are circulating without the preceding two hours and nineteen minutes. Two donors have called. One had not previously known the lab existed.
moderate.message: Out-of-context clip circulates (-10 rep, -$15k in donor management)

severe.name: Tech Backlash Movement
severe.description: A grassroots movement against AI development gains momentum. Your lab is a target.
severe.message: Anti-AI movement targets lab (-15 rep, -$40k, +8 doom)

severe.name: The Open Letter
severe.description: An open letter concerning 'laboratories of your type' collects eleven hundred signatures, including two of your advisors. Its demands are mutually exclusive. Every funder you have reads it as being specifically about you.
severe.message: Open letter names your type (-14 rep, -$35k, -10 research)

catastrophic.name: Protest Blockade
catastrophic.description: Protesters blockade your facilities. Operations grind to a halt.
catastrophic.message: Facility blockaded! Operations disrupted (+12 doom, -25 research, -$50k)

catastrophic.name: Doorstepped
catastrophic.description: A documentary crew has been filming the office entrance for a week. A researcher's home address appears on a forum. She relocates, then resigns by email, which is understandable and also a disaster.
catastrophic.message: Staff doorstepped; one resignation (-20 research, -15 rep, -$40k security retainer)

minor.name: Morale Issues
minor.description: Team surveys reveal declining job satisfaction. Productivity suffers.
minor.message: Low morale affects output (-8 research, -2 reputation)

minor.name: Internal Conflict
minor.description: Disagreements between team members escalate. Management intervention needed.

moderate.name: Key Resignation
moderate.description: A senior researcher announces they're leaving. They cite cultural concerns.
moderate.message: Senior researcher quits (-15 research, -5 rep, +3 doom)

moderate.name: Access Review
moderate.description: The quarterly access review finds fourteen former contractors still hold cluster credentials. One set was used last Tuesday. The review of who conducts the reviews is scheduled for next quarter.

severe.name: Data Leak
severe.description: Confidential research data appears online. Someone inside leaked it.
severe.message: Internal data leak! Competitor advantage gained (-20 rep, +8 doom, -20 research)

severe.name: The Essay
severe.description: An anonymous essay titled 'What My Safety Lab Won't Say' is published this morning. It contains a detail only nine people knew. All nine are reading it at their desks, in silence, at the same time.
severe.message: Anonymous insider essay published (-16 rep, -18 research, -$15k)

catastrophic.name: Sabotage Discovered
catastrophic.description: Someone has been deliberately corrupting your training runs. Months of work compromised.
catastrophic.message: Sabotage! Major setback (-40 research, +15 doom, -25 rep, -$30k)

catastrophic.name: Exit Interview
catastrophic.description: A departing senior researcher has taken the entire evaluation suite to a frontier lab. Legal reports the non-disclosure agreement was initialed but never signed: onboarding checklist item seven, unticked for four years.
catastrophic.message: Eval suite walked out the door (-35 research, -15 rep, -$40k)

minor.name: Budget Overrun
minor.description: This quarter's expenses exceeded projections. Tighter controls needed.

minor.name: Invoice Dispute
minor.description: A vendor disputes payment terms. Legal review required.

moderate.name: Funding Delay
moderate.description: A major grant disbursement is delayed. Cash flow tightens.
moderate.message: Grant delayed! Cash crunch (-$30k effective, +3 doom from stress)

moderate.name: Disallowed Costs
moderate.description: The funder's audit retroactively disallows an expense category. The category is 'catering', the retreat was two years ago, and the interest on the clawback accrues from the date of the sandwiches.

severe.name: Budget Shortfall
severe.description: Quarterly review reveals serious underfunding. Cuts must be made.
severe.message: Budget crisis! Emergency cuts required (-$50k, +6 doom)

severe.name: Restricted Funds
severe.description: The auditor finds restricted grant money has been quietly funding general operations for two quarters. Nothing was stolen; everything must nonetheless be paid back at once.
severe.message: Restricted funds reclassified immediately (-$55k, -15 research, -8 rep)

catastrophic.name: Runway Crisis
catastrophic.description: You have weeks of funding left. Without emergency action, the lab closes.
catastrophic.message: Runway crisis! Existential threat (+20 doom, -$80k, -15 rep)

catastrophic.name: The Bridge
catastrophic.description: Payroll clears by means of a bridge loan your treasurer describes as 'predatory, but available'. The lender's diligence questions suggest they understand your position better than your board does.
catastrophic.message: Predatory bridge loan accepted (-$70k, -12 rep, -15 research)
